title: Shifting Lens
summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City organised an educational guidance session for students appearing for their Class X Board Examinations.
description: Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City organised an educational guidance session for students appearing for their Class X Board Examinations. The session focused on helping students reduce examination stress, overcome fear, and build confidence. Students were also guided on effective techniques to prepare for Science and Mathematics more quickly and efficiently. The session encouraged them to make learning interesting, improve their understanding of concepts, and study effectively without relying on rote learning. The initiative aimed to empower students with practical study strategies and a positive mindset to perform better in their examinations.
location: The Byramji Jeejeebhoy Parsee Charitable School and Junior College, MUMBAI, Maharashtra
